title: 81309479-Development of a Spatial Planning and Management Information System for Ghana
description: The German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) supports the strengthening of public institutions in Ghana in implementing citizen-oriented, trustworthy, and accountable governance structures at national and local level through the project "Participatory, Accountability, and Integrity for a Resilience Democracy (PAIReD)" implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ). PAIReD runs from 10/2023 to 09/2027 and REACH runs from 01/09/2018 to 31/12/2025 with a potential extension until 31/03/2026. The European Union and the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) support the strengthening of public institutions at national and local level in Ghana to build resilience to climate change impacts in the Joint Programme Area (JPA) of the EU-Ghana Agricultural Programme. Supported by the two GIZ projects working on development and land-use planning in Ghana, the envisaged mission is as follows: 1) Design and develop the web-based spatial planning platform; 2) Develop a spatial data repository; 3) Provide capacity development for the technical staff of LUSPA at both national and regional levels along with all 60 partner MMDAs of PAIReD and 14 partner MMDAs of REACH on the usage and maintenance of the system. The new IT solution aims to provide a comprehensive platform for various stakeholders involved in land use planning and management, including Land Use Planners, Local Government Officials, Urban Developers, Citizens, and other stakeholders. The assignment will be carried out between January 2025 and June 2027 with a total of 285 (including options) person days for an international expert as Team Leader, 310 (including options) person days for the pool of experts with international expertise, and 750 (including options) person days for pool of experts with national expertise.

title: DEVELOPMENT OF SERIALIZER AND DESERIALIZER IP CORE FOR ULTRA DEEP SUB MICRON TECHNOLOGIES - EXPRO PLUS
description: To develop a Serializer and Deserializer IP Core, without any access restriction for European Industry, to provide a low power HighSpeed Serial Link up to 56GbpsDescription: Most of the required functionalities for the future space components such as processors, accelerators, routers, analog/digital converters will be developed within the GSTP activity GTE3-101ED "Ultra Deep Sub-Micron - Foundation and Platform Technology".The High Speed Serial Link (HSSL) is one of the key functionalities required for the next generation of space components that could not be included in the GTE3-101ED. Due to the importance to provide this functionality in a timely manner, this dedicated activityhas been defined with the aim to develop a Serializer and Deserializer (SERDES) IP Core to enableHSSL to at least 32Gbps and up to 56Gbps.This IP Core will support the different HSSL protocols used in space like SpaceFibre, Ethernet, PCIe, JESD204. Specifically the HSSL IP Core will be compliant to the newer PCIe 5.0 and Ethernet802.3cd link operation. TheHSSL IP Core will support power efficient operation both for short range as well as long range applications (two optimized implementations might be considered). The outcome of this activity shall be made available whenever required with concomitant activities, and in particular the GTE3- 101ED and shall be made accessible for future developments ofEuropean space products.The activity encompasses the following tasks :- Identify the space component requiring SERDES IP Core and targeted UDSM technology and foundry- Determine the HSSL requirement specifications and suitable commercial SERDES IP Core design- Perform Radiation test of selected HSSL in the targeted UDSM technology- Design radiation harden HSSL IP Core with improvedperformances- Validate the HSSL IP Core functionalities and performances on test vehicles, including radiation hardened operation- Demonstrate compliant operation on optimised and corrected design- Perform functional ESCC testing, characterization, andevaluation- Make the HSSL IP Core available and support the integration into the activity GTE3-101ED- Package the HSSL IP Core for use into future developments Deliverables include SERDES IP Core, Simulation model files, samples of the test chips and documentation as per applicable Standard for IC development, tailoredas required for the development of reusable IP.NOTE: This activity is currently in the GSTP Work Plan but will only be implemented after confirmation of financial support from Delegations. The final list of participating states will be known at tender issue.

title: T409-801GD LAUNCH CAMPAIGN PREPARATION AND OPERATIONS INTELLIGENT ASSISTANCE (EXPRO+)
description: Given the huge amounts and heterogeneity among the data collected during a launch campaign,the task of correlating information anddetecting unexpected behaviours is too complex for a humanoperator to handle. This becomes more evident when the data is stored indistributed machines,different formats (textual, graphs, TM, etc) and needs to be carefully investigated during critical andtime pressing operations like launches.An Intelligent Assistant is a software agent that can perform tasks or services for an end-user; itsrange of capabilities is wide and can be tailored to the user needs, ranging from fetching andcorrelating information across a variety of vast heterogeneous data sources, providing a humanlike interaction with the systems to automating tasks or training newcomers, avoiding the loss ofknow-how due to staff rotations. The key technology employed is Artificial Intelligence (AI). Morespecifically, an Intelligent Assistant consists mainly of a knowledge base and a communicationlayer. The first contains the knowledge from the field of expertise, an aggregated suitably preprocessed version of the available data sources (e.g. a Knowledge Graph), along with reasoningmethods. The communication layer provides a human-like interaction, employing Natural LanguageProcessing methods forsemantic parsing of human requests or documents, extracting intent,providing question and answering functionality, etc.The technology has the potential to completely transform the nature of accessing, correlating,sharing information and identifying key insights in data. Its benefits have been demonstrated indiverse industrial domains. To address space concepts, a domain-specific assistantis needed.However, the employment of such technology within the space sector is still in its infancy.
